title: Worker claim grant projection request
description: One committed manifest asking scripts/worker_claim_grant_projection_transition.py to project an Organization claim-allocator GRANTED receipt into control/worker-registry.json. The receipt travels as bytes (inline object) and is re-verified against the Organization ledger. A manifest grants nothing: authority NONE_PROJECTION_ONLY.

organization_receipt.description: The stegverse.organization-transition-receipt/v1 record exactly as stored at receipts/<digest>.json on refs/stegverse/organization-ledger.
